about: Tire types. Every car has one fixed wheel type; grip multiplies surface friction (planned, see docs/game-design.md). Ordered weakest to strongest overall.

road.name: Road tires
road.art: smooth highway rib tread, chrome or painted hubs

mud-terrain.name: Mud-terrain
mud-terrain.art: deep chunky mud lugs with open voids

flotation.name: Flotation
flotation.art: huge low-pressure balloon tires with wide paddle lugs

chained.name: Snow chains
chained.art: off-road mud-terrain tires wrapped in heavy steel chains; vary the chain style from truck to truck: ladder chains (straight cross links), diamond or square-pattern chains, V-bar cleated chains, or twin-ring tractor chains

spiked.name: Spiked studs
spiked.art: off-road mud-terrain tires studded with rows of short steel spikes

giant.name: Giant mining tires
giant.art: enormous mining-truck tires taller than a person, deep chevron tread
